how: Before the first M1 run, list the events you think the ending really depends on: a title in your own words and the chapter. Leave pool_id null. Once the pool exists, set pool_id to the id of the matching pool event, or leave it null if the pool doesn't have it.
provenance: Written after the reader had seen the first M1 pool (2026-10-12), so the picks may lean toward it and recall may read higher than an independent list would give.
